title: Return processed update
description: Confirm that a returned item was received and the refund is on its way. Utility WhatsApp template for retail returns. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Include the refund amount and expected timing; these are the details customers ask support about afterward.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we received your return for order *#{{order_id}}*. Your refund of {{amount}} will reach your original payment method within {{days}} business days.
